GetFullPage test fixtures

Deterministic local pages for manual and automated capture testing (spec §10).

  • e2e.html — automated correctness fixture (fixed header + colour bands)
  • short.html — single viewport
  • long.html — long static page with rulers
  • fixed-sticky.html — fixed header/footer, sticky sidebar, floating chat
  • lazy.html — lazy-loaded content revealed on scroll
  • infinite.html — infinite scroll (truncation behaviour)
  • nested-scroll.html — inner scroll container, body overflow hidden
  • transforms.html — CSS transforms, scroll-snap, smooth scroll
  • tall-wide.html — very tall and wide
  • rtl.html — RTL and vertical writing modes
